notablePrerequisites:
Followed Footsteps attached to a Merfolk you control.
Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block creatures you control.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token copy of the merfolk enchanted with Followed Footsteps.
Attack with Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets deals combat damage, sacrificing the token copy of the merfolk.
You get an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
